versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the Huawei Cloud AgentArts Observability No-Data Diagnosis skill.
- Provides systematic diagnosis for missing metrics, logs, and traces/sessions on the agent-ops platform.
- Checks subscription metadata, data pipeline integrity, query parameters, and authentication for APM, AOM, and LTS data sources.
- Generates root-cause analysis and recommended fixes for common no-data issues.
- Supports trigger phrases in both English and Chinese for versatile activation.
